claims.text: Cooper was killed during an attempt to arrest him at his hilltop property. The Southern Poverty Law Center's Intelligence Report of Spring 2002 describes a sheriff's operation involving seventeen officers, with two deputies in plain clothes, executed on a federal warrant issued in 1998 for tax evasion and bank fraud and a local warrant issued in July for aggravated assault with a deadly weapon. Cooper shot a deputy in the head and 'was killed by multiple shots before he made it inside'.

title: Southern Poverty Law Center, Intelligence Report, Spring 2002, issue 105, 'Conspiracy Theorist Slain in Police Shootout'
